This implies that Azacitidine may influence Dnmt1 through its interaction with Decitabine, which in turn affects Dnmt1's activity. The lowest common ancestor of these entities is an Organic Heteromonocyclic Compound, suggesting a shared structural or functional role in the pathway. The evidence supports a mechanistic link where Azacitidine could modulate Dnmt1 activity via Decitabine, though the exact nature of this interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
